title: Text to Speech for Videos

benefits.text: Scene length follows the voice, so nothing is cut off and nothing hangs in silence.

benefits.title: Word-level captions
benefits.text: Word timestamps come from the voice track, so highlighted captions stay in sync.

benefits.title: Edit one scene
